**Scope(s):** CROSS-OBJECT · **Row count:** 3 · **Lifecycle (candidate):** ACTIVE · **Layer (provisional):** LAYER-UNRESOLVED
**Notations:** A_K = persistent identity across transformations, K(t) has history/transition/destination, adhibhuta/adhidaiva/adhiyajna · **Aliases:** Chapter 8 persistence and time hypotheses, unmanifest != destroyed
